claims.quote: Variants in KCNT1, encoding a sodium-gated potassium channel (subfamily T member 1), have been associated with a spectrum of epilepsies and neurodevelopmental disorders.

claims.object_text: familial autosomal dominant or sporadic sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy
claims.quote: familial autosomal dominant or sporadic sleep-related hypermotor epilepsy
Genotypic analysis of the whole cohort of 248 individuals showed only missense mutations and one inframe deletion in KCNT1.
Recurrent KCNT1 mutations were seen to be associated with both severe and less severe phenotypes.
